designNotes: Classes are grouped into packages (items, persons, organizations, locations, events). Each package maps to a Java sub-package under org.javahelpers.simple.builders.performance_test.library.<package>. Each class entry has: name (Java identifier), kind ('class' or 'record'), extends (superclass name or null; ignored for records), and properties. Each property has: name, type (Java type string, e.g. 'String', 'List<Foo>', 'int[]'), optional default (generates @Default annotation), and optional ignore:true (generates @IgnoreInBuilder on setter). Property types that are not primitives, not in the script's STANDARD_IMPORTS list, and not declared as classes in this JSON are assumed to be enums from the .enums sub-package. The enums section defines enum types generated into the .enums sub-package. The baseClasses section defines the root entity class and intermediate base classes (one per package) that generated classes extend. Records get 'implements <Name>Builder.With' per the simple-builders convention.
